title: 水盤に落ちる夕日
summary: 18 時を過ぎると、図書館の深い軒と水盤に夕日が差し込んで、キャンパスがいちどだけ橙色になる。その時間に水盤の前へ。
summary_en: After 18:00, the sun slips under the library's deep eaves and across the pool, and for a moment the whole campus turns orange. Be in front of the pool at that hour.
rewardText: 今日いちばんの景色を見た
rewardText_en: You saw the best view of the day

steps.text: 18:00 以降に図書館の水盤の前へ行く
steps.text_en: Go to the library's reflecting pool after 18:00
